_about: Source for the Timeline app in ICS-OS (build_os.py reads and validates this file). A track is an ordered list of items; the file order is the display order. Item keys: refs (message codes such as C-24, document numbers such as 2.49, or scene:1.14), text (one line, optional), day (event day on the Cycle 300 Q4 calendar, Day 0 = Tuesday; optional), time (HH:MM, optional), when (a group heading that overrides everything else, e.g. Background). Anything not given is taken from the first message in refs: its Day, clock, or Week and weekday. Messages sent on a different day from the event show 'sent Day N' on their chip. An item with no refs, or with scenes only, is shown to the all-files account only. All of this is [PROPOSAL] unless the source file says otherwise.

tracks.label: EOD
tracks.blurb: From his first arrival to the last stand on Level 7.

items.text: The first arrival of EOD, seen from the Manager's earlier posting.
First appearance, Level 2 corridor.
His note in the drawer: the humans, disgusting and interesting at once, and the anger as he passes them. Day inferred.
Lior and Chidi talk about the man in the corridor with no badge.
A query to the Floor Liaison about the man in the corridor, and the reply.
K-7 asks the Manager, who writes to all PTKW to tread carefully.
The Manager forwards the old manual, minus its page, to K-7; K-7 sends it to all PTKW at 07:31.
EOD withdraws (derived; TIME_MODEL 1.3).
The off-facility demonstration: Blue Harrow Team of the Harrow, Sudbury.
Gyrfalcon Wing incident: a four-aircraft flight, a radio contact with an unidentified presence, no casualties.
Open water off the coast: both alert flights engage EOD and ARM-27. Eight pilots dead, no hits (to 03:41).
Hallvik tower: EOD enters the cab and speaks plainly to Colonel Aronsen (to 03:59).
The atrium act.
The Research Team requests the field report; the Branch replies at 21:40 that it cannot place him for the ten days.
The Deployment 287 master summary.
The sealed Study of Eirik's Smile.
The discussion of EOD sunsetting. Two readers; EOD excluded.
The Manager argues for holding the order and prepares Level 7 as a farewell floor.
Chidi and Ruth discuss the sheet they each read once and do not have.
A human asset says "[Subjugator]" at his desk; a scan of the Doc 2.15 designation block is found in his drawer. Report filed 19:05.
Does EOD have a Step 5?
The PTKW investigation team redacts the Day 31 chat as evidence.
The Manager finds EOD's pencil sheet and transcribes it; counts triggers a, b and c of C-24; gives the second decision (07:40). The Team grants the floor (11:50).
Result of the B-26 investigation: the page was cut by the Research Division.
The Team's confirmation issues; Level 7 closes under the recertification pretext.
"INFLATABLE CROWD SOLUTIONS" is written on the Level 3 corridor wall; found 05:40 on Day 36.
Level 7 sealed. The fourteen enter at 02:00. The scene stops before the end.
